decision_rule: A failed floor gate reads CURVE_TOO_WEAK and voids the rung. Otherwise, if any probe window's character-count labelling cleared its shuffle draws, the previous rung's invariance fork decides: INVARIANT when all period gaps are at most 10 characters, else PROPORTIONAL when all period-to-width ratio gaps are at most 0.1, else MIXED; exactly one clearing window is UNDETERMINED by design. If only the token-position labelling cleared, the reading is TOKEN_ONLY_PATTERN and the fork is not entered. If nothing cleared, the reading is PRECONDITION_WITHOUT_RIPPLE when the number of directions reached 4 at any window, and PRECONDITION_ABSENT_AT_1P4B when it did not.
metric: One call per endpoint, and the pre-registered headline reading, from the records written beside this one.
notes: The four pre-registered readings are CURVE_TOO_WEAK, PRECONDITION_ABSENT_AT_1P4B, PRECONDITION_WITHOUT_RIPPLE, and the previous rung's fork. A failed floor makes every pattern number here uninterpretable as evidence about the model, so the whole rung is void in that case and the next rung is a human decision. A clearing under the token-position labelling alone reads TOKEN_ONLY_PATTERN and does not enter the fork. Exactly one clearing window is left undetermined by design, not decided. This rung is a single run, unlike the twice-measured rung below it, and could land differently on a repeat elsewhere. A further run of this script on the same box is a rerun of the same instrument, not a replication.
